select t.*,
tf.id as "tf_id", tfs.id as "tf_resourcesId", tfs.file_name as "tf_fileName", tfs.extension as "tf_extension", tfs.size as "tf_size", tfs.content_type as "tf_contentType", tf.expiration_date as "tf_expirationDate", tf.description as "tf_description", tf.type as "tf_type", tf.status as "tf_status",
tp.id as "tp_id", tps.id as "tp_resourcesId", tps.file_name as "tp_fileName", tps.extension as "tp_extension", tps.size as "tp_size", tps.content_type as "tp_contentType", tp.expiration_date as "tp_expirationDate", tp.description as "tp_description", tp.type as "tp_type", tp.status as "tp_status" from ( select ti.id as "id", ti.unit as "unit", ti.in_service_date as "inServiceDate", ti.license_plate as "licensePlate", ti.year as "year", ti.gross_weight as "grossWeight", ti.axles as "axles", ti.vin as "vin", ti.includeifta as "includeIFTA", ti.description as "description", ti.status as "status",
s.id as "stateId", s.name as "stateName", c.id as "countryId", c.name as "countryName",
tmk.id as "modelMakerId", tmk.name as "modelMakerName",
ft.id as "fuelTypeId", ft.name as "fuelTypeName",
ot.id as "ownershipTypeId", ot.name as "ownershipTypeName",
dr.id as "driverId", dr.first_name || ' ' || dr.last_name as "driverName",
com.id as "companyId", com.name as "companyName",
u.id as "createdById", u.name as "createdByName",
ti.created as "created" from trucks ti left join states s on s.id = ti.state_id left join countries c on c.id = s.country_id left join truck_model_makers tmk on tmk.id = ti.model_maker_id left join fuel_types ft on ft.id = ti.fuel_type_id left join ownership_types ot on ot.id = ti.ownership_type_id left join drivers dr on dr.id = ti.driver_id left join companies com on com.id = ti.company_id left join users u on u.id = ti.created_by_id where 1=1
and ti.company_id||'' = #{companyId}
) t left join truck_files tf on tf.truck_id = t.id and tf.status = 'ACTIVE' left join resources tfs on tfs.id = tf.resource_id left join permits tp on tp.truck_id = t.id and tp.status = 'ACTIVE' left join resources tps on tps.id = tp.resource_id
